description: What the user's ApplySent profile still needs before applications can go out, and how many employer questions wait. Reports what is missing, not the values. Reads only.
name: get_profile_status

missing.description: What the profile still needs, in words.

pending_questions.description: How many employer questions wait on the user.

ready.description: True when the profile has everything an application needs.

tailor_resume.description: Whether the user asked for a résumé tailored to each job.

targets.description: What the user targets, as the profile records it.

job_titles.description: The job titles the user targets.

workplace_types.description: The workplace types the user targets.

items.description: One workplace type, e.g. remote or hybrid.

title: Check profile readiness
